narrative: In the account book. The account book open at home. One new line. Nothing written under it. The earlier page is not turned back to a total. Both locks are undone. In the account book. The book is shut. Both locks are turned. No sum is written on the cover or on a slip beside it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the share and shut both locks.
